result.pass: Output matched what the task asked for. XP awarded.
result.compileFail: The code did not compile. Read the errors above and try again.
result.runtimeError: It ran but threw an error. Fix it and run again.
result.mismatch: Expected a line equal to "{expected}". Adjust your code and run again.
result.verifyFail: Your code printed the right answer for this example, but a hidden check with different inputs failed. Make the logic work for any input, not just this one.
result.error: Something went wrong running the code.
result.gitPass: The repository has the shape the task asked for. XP awarded.

run.bootFailedHelp: The compiler could not start. Reload the page (Ctrl+Shift+R, or Cmd+Shift+R on a Mac) to fetch it again.
errors.heading: Let's fix this first
errors.note: Often a single early mistake (a missing or extra { } ( ) ;) is enough to confuse the rest. Fix the top one first, then run again.
errors.warningNote: The compiler built this, so it is not an error. It is telling you these lines cannot be doing what they look like they do. Code that runs and is still wrong is the expensive kind.

landing.heading: Learn C# - and how software really works
landing.lead: Three ways in. The practical track teaches C# by building and running real code in your browser. The theory track starts from zero - what software is and how a computer actually runs it. The AI track opens up how large language models and agents work under the hood. Pick one - you can switch any time.
